item.title: PepsiCo to slash prices on popular snacks after consumer backlash
item.description: PepsiCo said it will slash prices on popular snacks like Lay's, Doritos, and Cheetos in response to consumer complaints about rising costs.

item.title: 'Super Bowl Breakfast' returns with focus on leadership and legacy ahead of NFL showcase
item.description: Super Bowl Breakfast emcee Brent Jones discussed the 38th annual Athletes in Action event, which will feature Andrew Luck, Condoleezza Rice and Christian McCaffrey.

item.title: These states are considering eliminating property taxes for homeowners
item.description: Efforts to ease or eliminate property tax burdens are underway in North Dakota, Wyoming, Florida, Texas and Indiana as lawmakers consider alternative funding mechanisms.

item.title: Redemption Bank's historic Utah launch backed by former White House policy advisor, NFL and NBA stars
item.description: Redemption Bank became the 24th Black-owned Minority Depository Institution after Redemption Holding Co. acquired Holladay Bank & Trust with investors including Ally Financial.

item.title: Trump-appointed Fed Governor Stephen Miran resigns from White House post
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran resigned from his CEA chair role to focus full-time on his Fed position, as required by federal law and regulations.

item.title: Just 17% of voters think now is a good time to buy a home as affordability concerns weigh: poll
item.description: Housing crisis deepens as 76% of renters believe they'll never afford homeownership, while sentiment hits historic lows, according to a new poll.

item.title: Costco fans reportedly name dairy item as a must-buy that justifies membership
item.description: Costco's Tillamook cheese blocks offer incredible savings at just 28 cents per ounce, beating competitors by up to 34 cents per ounce for smart shoppers.

item.title: McDonald's offers free McNugget caviar kits for Valentine's Day celebration
item.description: McDonald's partners with Paramount Caviar to offer limited-edition McNugget caviar kits featuring Baerii Sturgeon caviar and $25 Arch Cards beginning Feb. 10.

item.title: Elon Musk calls police raid on X offices a 'political attack' amid French criminal probe
item.description: French authorities raided X's Paris offices and summoned Elon Musk and former CEO Linda Yaccarino over alleged crimes linked to AI chatbot Grok, escalating European regulatory tensions.
